name: Nha Le
intro: Hi, I’m Nha — a graphic design graduate who enjoys creating thoughtful visual identities, book covers, posters, and playful visual stories.
about: I’m a 2026 Graphic Design graduate from Wichita State University. I love combining clear visual communication with warm, considered details, and I’m excited to keep learning through meaningful creative work.
contactText: I’d love to hear from you. Let’s make something thoughtful together.

projects.title: Classic Literature — Book Cover Redesigns
projects.description: A curated collection of three classic literature book-cover redesign concepts, presented in a playful scrapbook-inspired editorial layout. The three book covers shown on the folder are illustrative placeholders.

projects.title: Clean Ocean — Book Cover
projects.description: A minimalist cover concept for a psychological fiction story, focused on mood, clarity, and visual tension.

projects.title: Graphic Design Campaigns
projects.description: A collection of visual communication projects exploring national branding, local rebranding, event design, and printed pieces.

projects.title: Green Strike — Interactive Design
projects.description: A UI/UX course project exploring app concepts, habit-building, and clear digital experiences.

projects.title: Jettribe Championship Trophy
projects.description: A layered trophy concept combining racing imagery, logo placement, dimensional plates, and production-aware details.

projects.title: Whispers of the Moon
projects.description: A dreamy book cover exploring memory, solitude, and the beauty of the night.
